item.title: Equestrian Terms: The Complete Glossary
item.description: <From "on the bit" to "oxer," equestrian terms can feel like a foreign language to the uninitiated. This definitive glossary covers every corner of the discipline — so you can ride, watch, and converse with genuine confidence.>
